note: Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS; NT revised 2003). Its New Testament is on disk whole (ebible mirror gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh); the mirror has no Old Testament, so OT quotations reuse a shipped Amharic work's wording where one quotes the same verse (source_file names it) and are otherwise self_rendered in the 1962 register.

A `mined` row was re-measured against the finished text: an exact byte substring of at least 20 characters of the 1962 NT verse (or 25 of the cited shipped work) inside that block. Shorter, re-personed, or bridged-range verses (the mirror merges some verse ranges into one entry holding only part of the text) are self_rendered.
